newsitem.title: USA: Electric Boat, Newport News in sub talks.
newsitem.headline: Electric Boat, Newport News in sub talks.

text.p: Electric Boat Co. might team up with rival Newport News Shipbuilding to build the U.S. Navy's next-generation submarine, but it's too early to discuss details, an Electric Boat spokesman said Tuesday.
Electric Boat is a subsidiary of General Dynamics.
"We're not saying very much right now, because it's very preliminary," Electric Boat spokesman Neil Ruenzel told Reuters.
Electric Boat said Monday that at the Navy's encouragement, it was in "exploratory discussions" with Newport News Shipbuilding to team up on the so-called "new attack submarine" project.
Electric Boat and Newport News Shipbuilding are the only two U.S. companies capable of building nuclear ships.

"These discussions are a logical outgrowth of the ongoing Navy/industry effort to examine all cost-saving opportunities, while producing submarines with advanced capabilities," Electric Boat President John Welch said in a statement on Monday.
